title: Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned under this name in Shabbat 88a, where he said: this teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, held the mountain over them like a barrel; and in Avodah Zarah 2b the statement is repeated in the name of Rav Dimi bar Chama, while in Dikdukei Soferim the reading is 'Avdimi'; and in Eruvin 55a, 'Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Duba' [asks], what is the meaning of that which is written, 'It is not in heaven,' etc., while Dikdukei Soferim reads 'bar Chasa'; and in Avodah Zarah 19a, 'Rav Avdimi bar Chama said: whoever occupies himself with Torah,' etc.; and in Horayot 10a, 'Rav Avdimi bar Chama said: this excludes the nasi,' etc. And in Zevachim 118a, 'Rav Avdimi bar Chasa,' while the reading of Shitah Mekubetzet is 'bar Chama,' and Dikdukei Soferim has 'bar Chama bar Dosa.'

notes.text: All Avdimi/Dimi and Chama/Chasa/Duba/Dosa readings remain as Hyman lists them, without a new identity merger.
The checked Shabbat passage explicitly gives the title Rav.

The consulted Shabbat 88a explicitly has Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa and the mountain like a barrel. The other Avdimi/Dimi and Chama/Chasa/Duba/Dosa forms, including exact Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet readings not inspected here, remain occurrence-specific reports by Hyman.
